title: Polar Depth for Potentially Heavy-Tailed Data
summary: Motivated by the analysis of the behaviour of extremes from multivariate heavy-tailed distributions, we introduce a novel notion of statistical depth, referred to as Polar Depth. The polar depth function is naturally expressed in polar coordinates, as is the limiting distribution of a regularly varying random variable, beyond asymptotically large thresholds, once its marginals have been appropriately normalized.
